---
title: "Life Expectancy"
format: html
---

```{r setup}

library(tidyverse)
library(ghost)

```

```{r data}

inds <- gho_indicators()

gho_dimensions()

gho_dimension_values(dim = 'HRH_06')

who_gho_indicators_test_df <- gho_data(inds = 'HRH_10')


who_gho_indicators_dfs <- list()

i <- 100
max_i <- 1000

for(i in 1:max_i) {
  indicator_data <- gho_data(inds = inds$IndicatorCode[i], "$filter=SpatialDimType eq 'COUNTRY'")
  
  if(!is.null(indicator_data) && nrow(indicator_data) > 0) {
    who_gho_indicators_dfs[[i]] <- indicator_data
    cat(paste0("Indicator Code: ", indicator_data$IndicatorCode[1], " Iteration: ", i, "\n"))
  } else {
    cat(paste0("No data for Indicator Code: ", inds$IndicatorCode[i], " Iteration: ", i, "\n"))
  }
}

who_gho_indicators_df <- bind_rows(who_gho_indicators_dfs)

who_gho_indicators_clean_2014_long_df <- who_gho_indicators_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(NumericValue),
         TimeDim == '2014')


who_gho_indicators_clean_2014_df <- who_gho_indicators_clean_2014_long_df %>%
  mutate(field_value = if_else(
    is.na(Dim1), as.character(IndicatorCode), 
    paste0(IndicatorCode, "__", Dim1))) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(SpatialDim, TimeDim),
      names_from = field_value,
      values_from = NumericValue,
      names_sep = "__"
    )

value_definitions_df <- who_gho_indicators_clean_2014_long_df %>%
  mutate(name = paste0("N_COUNTRIES_", TimeDim)) %>%
  group_by(IndicatorCode, name) %>%
  summarise(COUNT = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(IndicatorCode),
              values_from = COUNT,
              names_from = name)


```
